Inline markers inside a code span stay literal content

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p><code>a<em>b</em><ins>c</ins></code></p>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
